localAdaptations: Package.swift: expose Swift demoqa, native host mouse input, host camera/guest recorder relay, and recorder regression tests

Sources/DemoDriverKit/NativeInteractionDriver.swift: verified native window/menu/clipboard/scroll operations; optional explicit host mouse route with no guest-injection fallback, per-event input validation and guaranteed drag release

Sources/DemoQA/DemoQA.swift: five localized scenarios from a hash-verified source manifest; travel notes, camera instructions, actual video playback, mixed-direction Japanese reading order, and interactive game dialogue; verify native copy/paste, changed translations and recalled window geometry; timestamp chapter/caption cues and actual key input against the recorder first-frame epoch; retain separate Settings and Fit regression collection; retain sanitized host input session evidence; prepare the native Separate window before recording and verify its initial and recalled frames without repositioning during the story; move Preview clipboard documents through a visible native titlebar drag without resizing and suppress the chapter only during the measured opening interval; retain readable Copy Image pacing and omit internal caret navigation from badges while preserving actual keystroke evidence; finish Preview movement with ordinary blank-paper deselection and preserve separate native Preview AX evidence
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/RecorderOptions.swift: explicitly select HEVC or H.264; unsupported requested codec settings fail
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/CadenceWriter.swift: separate cadence producer and encoder; preserve collected frame timestamps through bounded backpressure; drain GPU copies and encoder before finalization

Sources/DemoRecorderKit/MetalFrameCopier.swift: Metal-only deep copies into a bounded compatible pixel buffer pool; retain source and destination buffers and CVMetalTexture wrappers until GPU completion; fail on GPU or shutdown errors
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/BoundedFrameQueue.swift: enforce capacity, monotonic timestamps, ordered acknowledgement and producer shutdown
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/CadenceAccounting.swift: distinguish skipped producer slots from rejected frames
Sources/DemoRecorderKit/DisplayRecorder.swift: pass the requested codec into the writer
Tests/RecorderTests/RecorderTests.swift: explicit codecs, cadence accounting, backpressure, ordering, queue bounds, shutdown, actual Metal pixels and GPU resource lifetime

Sources/HostRecorder/HostRecorder.swift: capture the complete native-pixel viewport of one verified owned VM window on the host; retain real host cursor, source geometry, first-frame clock and executable hash; finalize on guest story completion

Sources/RecorderRelay/RecorderRelay.swift: synchronize host camera with guest narration using measured direct TCP clock round trips before and after the take; reject excessive uncertainty/drift and copy only finalized camera evidence

Sources/HostMouseRelay/HostMouseRelay.swift: authenticated, peer-restricted native host mouse input mapped into the owned VM view, per-event frame/focus validation, immediate clock responses and sanitized input traces
Sources/DemoDriverKit/HostMouseRelayClient.swift: bounded TCP connection and validated request/response IDs for native mouse input, clocks and session provenance
sourceBoundary: Base recorder and input sources were copied from the 2026-09-09 working-tree snapshot, which included uncommitted changes. HEAD alone does not identify them. Native product workflows were added on 2026-09-10 and redesigned around five distinct original scenarios on 2026-09-11. Host capture, native host input and clock synchronization were added locally on 2026-09-11. Camera scene.json and recorder/input sidecars identify actual deployed executables separately from source hashes.
